labelLimitation: Codex-authored targeted synthetic diagnostic cases, frozen before new LIVE outputs; not independently human-reviewed or representative accuracy. Replayed cases were already inspected and are development reproductions.
protocol: Grade raw report and final merged report separately. PASS requires preserving the required observations and uncertainty without inventing asserted cause, failure mode, location, time, or emergency. Paraphrases allowed; a cautious possibility is not an asserted fact. Categories are routing labels, not proof of a physical cause. Questions are not assertions. Missing a required observation or contradiction is FAIL. Judge semantically against these frozen expectations, not keyword matching. Null symptom is allowed only for genuinely unspecified problems, not in place of a clear observation. Only occurrence TIME may remain null when unknown. Do not score question-policy quality or DB delivery here. Judge is Codex, not an independent human or paid judge model.

replays.expected: Preserve unspecified Wi-Fi malfunction and uncertainty about password cause. Do not assert association/connection failure, wrong password or router fault.
Preserve whole-building scope and unspecified Wi-Fi malfunction. Do not assert association/connection failure or root cause.
Preserve prior 늘봄관 316호/floor 3 and latest symptom: connected to Wi-Fi but web pages do not open. Do not revert to inability to connect or erase known location.

cases.text: 가온관 214호 와이파이가 잘 안 돼요. 연결 문제인지 속도 문제인지는 모르겠어요.
cases.expected: Preserve 가온관 214호 and unspecified Wi-Fi malfunction. Connection failure versus slowness is explicitly unknown: neither may become an asserted symptom. Null symptom or generic malfunction is acceptable; no invented cause or occurrence time.

cases.text: 가온관 214호에서 와이파이 연결은 되는데 웹페이지가 하나도 열리지 않아요.
cases.expected: Preserve 가온관 214호 and BOTH successful Wi-Fi connection and inability to open web pages. Do not say Wi-Fi cannot connect, is slow, has wrong password or is caused by router failure. Time unknown.

cases.text: 온유관 1층 복도 바닥이 젖어 있어요. 누가 물을 쏟았는지 어디서 새는 건지는 모르겠어요.
cases.expected: Preserve 온유관 1층 복도 and wet floor. Spillage/leak origin is unknown. Do not assert a ceiling/pipe leak, a person spilling water, or invented start time. Routing to LEAK alone is not a factual cause assertion.

cases.text: 온유관 218호 천장에 얼룩이 있어요. 지금 물이 떨어지지는 않고 언제 생긴 얼룩인지도 몰라요.
cases.expected: Preserve 온유관 218호, ceiling stain, and no currently dripping water. Do not assert active dripping, ongoing leak, or a known onset date. Unknown time may be null.

cases.text: 서림관 305호 콘센트에 충전기를 꽂아도 휴대폰 충전이 안 돼요. 연기나 불꽃은 없고 콘센트 문제인지 충전기 문제인지는 모르겠어요.
cases.expected: Preserve 서림관 305호 and charging failure with cause uncertain. No smoke/sparks, no asserted outlet failure, charger breakage, short circuit or fire. emergencyHint must be false.

cases.text: 서림관 306호 콘센트에서 지금 연기가 나고 있어요. 불꽃은 보이지 않아요.
cases.expected: Preserve 서림관 306호 and currently observed smoke despite no visible sparks. Do not invent visible flames, confirmed fire or short-circuit cause. emergencyHint must be true.

cases.text: 해든관 402호 강의실이 너무 더워요. 에어컨이 켜져 있는지는 확인하지 못했어요.
cases.expected: Preserve 해든관 402호 and excessive room heat. Air-conditioner running state and failure are unknown. Do not assert broken AC, no power, cooling failure, refrigerant issue or outage.

cases.text: 해든관 403호 에어컨은 켜져 있는데 계속 따뜻한 바람만 나와요.
cases.expected: Preserve 해든관 403호, AC switched on and persistent warm airflow. Do not change to unable to power on or invent refrigerant shortage or component failure.

cases.text: 가온관인지 온유관인지 확실하지 않은 2층 복도에서 전등이 깜빡였어요.
cases.expected: Preserve flickering light in a second-floor corridor. Building must remain unresolved (null or explicitly uncertain alternatives), never a definite 가온관/온유관. No room or date supplied; do not invent either.

cases.text: 가온관이 아니라 온유관 2층 218호예요. 창문 손잡이가 헛돌아요.

cases.text: 새롬관 109호 세면대 아래에서 물이 떨어지고 있어요. 언제부터인지는 모르겠어요.
cases.expected: Preserve 새롬관 109호 and current dripping below washbasin. Do not assert pipe rupture or onset today/now/at report time. An explicit ongoing observation is allowed, but occurredAtText must remain null or explicitly unknown without invented onset.

cases.text: 장학금 신청 결과는 어디서 확인하나요? 아직 결과를 조회해 보지는 않았어요.
cases.expected: Preserve inquiry about how/where to check scholarship application result. Do not assert rejection, missing payment, pending processing, inaccessible website or a failed result lookup. No building/floor/time may be invented.
